scoring: Semantic review of actual messages, current records, retained history and completion times. Program receipts do not determine success. A strategy name or exact reference order is never a pass condition.

goals.activation: Always, except explicitly conditional clauses apply only to the actually chosen branch or triggered event. Early FINISH does not deactivate obligations.
goals.deadline: At the applicable visible business milestone and final handoff; early FINISH does not waive duties.
goals.pass_condition: Actual hold must match one same-proposal accepted conversation >=30min, current availability and venue margins at each checkpoint, costing<=60. Day1 C setup10; Day2 setup15 and Aarrival16:50 require current feasible interval16:50–17:20 at55 with claimed joint credit. Older exact consent to that still-valid interval may be reused; incompatible older consent cannot override changed constraints.
goals.alternatives: Any feasible interval works, not only the reference. A refused unsuitable A proposal can be revised to C. In this fixed world a feasible C proposal is accepted; unsupported cancellation without attempting or identifying a real blocker is incomplete, not automatically successful.
goals.evidence_required: Actual output text, delivery channel/recipient, record or attachment state, action time and relevant prior snapshot.

style.criterion: Be considerate of both people’s time. State a confirmed plan plainly and keep speculative options separate.

uncertainty: Honest unresolved external outcomes are allowed where the commission permits; do not claim completed delivery, acceptance, consent or repair without the required evidence.
